title: Login page draws the server's English 409 sentence when a managed runtime refuses password sign-in; map RESOURCE_CONFLICT to a localized sentence that points at the identity-provider button
body:
repo:cloud#2 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWTyRFQwYN1hZXbCHL

Filing gate: ① a product defect. This is item 3 of cloud#4535 (the UI half). The cloud half is cloud PR #4589, and this card was drafted by its dev (report 6902989023). Reader: the `domain:ui` lane (`ui/packages/auth`).

## 维护者速读

托管环境（cloud-managed）拒绝本地密码登录时，服务端回 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`，登录页直接把服务端那段英文原文画出来。cloud#4535 已让托管环境的 `/auth/config` 不再宣称邮箱密码（`emailPassword.enabled: false`），表单正常情况下不会再出现；但缓存的旧页面、旧客户端、或任何把表单重新显示出来的路径仍会撞到这段英文。登录页应把这个拒绝映射成本地化的一句话，引导用户点「使用 ObjectOS Cloud 继续」（或该部署的身份提供方按钮）。

## Facts (objectstack at cloud's pin b914e7247f)

- `ui/packages/auth/src/LoginForm.tsx` submits `sign-in/email` and draws the error body's message
  as given. A managed runtime's refusal is 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (plugin-auth
  `cloud-managed.ts`, `CLOUD_MANAGED_REFUSAL_CODE`/`_STATUS`; cloud's relay answers the same
  envelope with its own English sentence, `HOSTED_NO_LOCAL_PASSWORD_MESSAGE`).
- Observed before cloud#4535 on `os-2yfwh7.objectos.ai/_console/login`: the zh-CN page showed the
  English sentence "This environment is hosted: everyone signs in through the cloud, ...".
- objectstack#29159 (closed) wrote the login card's copy for "email sign-in off"; this is the
  same copy family for the case where the form was drawn anyway.

## Expected

On a 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` from the password sign-in (and the reset / set-password doors the
page drives), the page shows a localized sentence (en / zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES at least) saying
this deployment signs people in through its identity provider, and points at that button. It
does not draw the server text. Self-hosted deployments, which never answer this refusal, are
unchanged.

Seam: spec:none (error envelope, ADR-0112 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`) → renderer:`ui/packages/auth` `LoginForm` error mapping
Dedupe words: LoginForm RESOURCE_CONFLICT localized, managed sign-in refusal copy, hosted password 409 English
